## Message

```
[X18N6001] No translator <detail>
├▶ fix: Add a translator plugin, such as `@x18n/translator-ai`, and list its id in `translate.translators` if you set that option.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.dev/errors/x18n6001
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

`x18n translate` calls the translators of plugins, and the project has none for this locale.

1. Add a translator plugin, such as `@x18n/translator-ai`, to `plugins`.
2. If you set `translate.translators` or `translate.locales`, check that they list its id. `x18n translators` prints the ids and the chain per locale.
3. Without a translator, an agent can still translate with `x18n prompt translate`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
